why: The playtest bundle reports itself as having FORCED a flag the URL asked for directly. A UI reading these notes would tell the player 'turned on by playtest, not requested directly' about a control they set themselves, and offer to remove a parameter that is doing real work. The mutation is invisible to any assertion that only checks the bundle's members are on -- they are, either way -- which is why the test compares the forced SET against `expandsTo` minus the directly-requested flag rather than counting. Scoped to dev-config.test.ts; expectFailures counts that scoped run only.
killedBy: explainDevConfig names each bundle member it forced, and does not claim one the URL asked for
